scope_summary: One selected AWS account; creates or reconciles one prefixed IAM deployment user, one customer-managed thesis-demo-v2 policy, their attachment, and one access key.

permission_groups.scope: IAM users named twin2mc-* in the selected account
Customer-managed policies named twin2mc-* and their attachment only to the generated twin2mc-* user
Generated user access key and the exact dedicated submitted key when its owner can be proven

credential_cleanup: Detach the exact gate-owned customer-managed policy, delete every non-default policy version, and delete the policy before deleting the generated user.
Delete only the exact submitted access-key ID after proving its IAM user owner.
Record STS provider expiry instead of claiming early revocation.
Return manual_revocation_required when ownership or delete authority cannot be proven.
limitations: AWS root access keys are forbidden.

The historical admin-v1 inline-policy path cannot carry thesis-demo-v2 because an IAM user has a 2,048-character aggregate inline-policy quota; v2 therefore uses one customer-managed policy whose document must remain below 6,144 characters.
IAM create operations and caller discovery cannot be fully resource-scoped before the generated ARN exists.
The pack is offline evidence and requires IAM Access Analyzer plus a separately approved live validation.
